import json
P='/home/ubuntu/runs/paper/glm-hpl-u1-turns/play/users/u000/system/state/workspace/programs/task-77262100'
demos=json.load(open(P+'.json'))

def parse(g): pass

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find vertical 2-line column
    L=None
    for c in range(W):
        if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(H)): L=c; break
    # find shape cells (non-background, non-2, non... shape = most common non-line color? use cells != line color and not the background)
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    line_col=2
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    if bg==2: bg=[c for c,_ in cnt.most_common() if c!=2][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
    rows=sorted({r for r,c in cells}); cols=sorted({c for r,c in cells})
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    shape=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    # clear old area
    for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=bg
    # move shape flush against line, staying on its side
    w=c1-c0+1
    if c0>L: nc0=L+1
    else: nc0=L-w
    for i,row in enumerate(shape):
        for j,v in enumerate(row):
            if v!=bg: g[r0+i][nc0+j]=v
    # 8-line at old right edge
    for r in range(H): g[r][c1]=8
    return g

ok=True
for i,d in enumerate(demos):
    out=transform(d['input'])
    m=out==d['output']
